question: Should the durable approval registry land as the first incremental foundation after exact-head authorization and restart proof, or should the stacked approval work remain draft until the complete cross-surface lifecycle is reviewed together?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but accepting a new persistent security-sensitive Gateway protocol and its incremental rollout boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the proven foundation
options.body: Resolve the conflict and require exact-head reviewer-isolation, concurrent-resolution, and restart-readback proof before merging this first increment.

options.title: Hold the complete stack
options.body: Keep this and the dependent channel and native-client PRs in draft until the entire cross-surface product direction can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Land the proven foundation
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict and require exact-head reviewer-isolation, concurrent-resolution, and restart-readback proof before merging this first increment.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked feature direction and current-main approval lifecycle history are concentrated in this person's recent work.
